definitions.explanation: An annual event held at universities and some high schools where students organize food stalls, performances, exhibitions, and other activities. Open to the public, it is a major social and cultural event in Japanese academic life.

examples.japanese: {学園祭|がくえんさい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつ→いつ：00536_itsu⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
{学園祭|がくえんさい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{模擬店|もぎてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ことになった。
examples.english: We ended up running a stall at the school festival.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{学園祭|がくえんさい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な⟦バンド→バンド：05508_bando⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧らしい。
examples.english: Apparently a famous band is coming to this year's campus festival.

notes:
Typically held in autumn (October–November) at Japanese universities, lasting two to three days. Students form committees ({実行委員会|じっこういいんかい}) months in advance to organize the event. Activities include {模擬店|もぎてん} (food and game stalls), live music, plays, art exhibits, and academic presentations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {学園祭|がくえんさい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧: festival preparations
- {学園祭|がくえんさい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{模擬店|もぎてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to run a stall at the festival
- {学園祭|がくえんさい}⟦{実行委員|じっこういいん}→実行委員：23542_jikkouiin⟧: festival organizing committee member

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{文化祭|ぶんかさい}→文化祭：05589_bunkasai⟧: cultural festival — used mainly for junior high and high school events
- {大学祭|だいがくさい}: university festival — synonym, slightly more formal
